title: ErrorResult.Reason must stay mapped in grpcCodeFromReason to avoid lossy HTTP->gRPC code collisions
answers: Why is a 409/400 error reported with the wrong gRPC code (AlreadyExists vs Aborted, InvalidArgument vs FailedPrecondition)?
ErrorResult with HTTP 200 incorrectly reported as success
Adding a new error reason to unified storage and getting it mapped correctly to a gRPC status code
body:
Symptom: several gRPC codes collapse onto the same HTTP status (409 -> AlreadyExists or Aborted; 400 family -> InvalidArgument/FailedPrecondition/OutOfRange), causing ambiguous or wrong gRPC codes in metrics/logging; also an ErrorResult with httpCode 200 was mislabeled as success.
Root cause: the old grpcCodeFromHTTPStatus mapped HTTP status alone, which is inherently lossy.
Fix pattern: grpcCodeFromErrorResult first consults res.Reason via grpcCodeFromReason (a metav1.StatusReason -> grpccodes.Code table) and only falls back to the HTTP-status heuristic when the reason is empty or unrecognized (logging a warning in that case); a non-nil ErrorResult can never return OK — httpCode 200 with a non-nil ErrorResult now maps to Internal with a warning.
Constraints: when unified storage starts producing a new metav1.StatusReason, add a case to grpcCodeFromReason or it silently falls back to the coarser HTTP-code mapping (logged as "Unrecognized error reason"); this translation is used for internal labeling/metrics, not for the actual gRPC status returned to clients.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/resource error-to-grpc-code translation (used for metrics/labels on ErrorResult responses)

search: Map ErrorResult.Reason via grpcCodeFromReason in grpcCodeFromErrorResult to prevent lossy HTTP-to-gRPC code collisions (e.g., 409 ambiguously mapping to AlreadyExists or Aborted). Consult res.Reason first through the metav1.StatusReason table; only fall back to HTTP-status heuristic with a warning if reason is empty or unrecognized. Never return OK for a non-nil ErrorResult; httpCode 200 with non-nil result maps to Internal with warning. When unified storage introduces a new metav1.StatusReason, add a case to grpcCodeFromReason or it silently falls back to coarser HTTP mapping. Used for internal metrics/labels on ErrorResult responses, not client-facing gRPC status. Affects pkg/storage/unified/resource/errors.go.
